# Tristan Vegas — Web Developer Portfolio

> Tristan Vegas is a detail-oriented Web Developer from the Philippines (Camarines Sur) with a Bachelor's degree in Information Technology. Full-stack experience across Next.js, React, Vue.js, Angular, Node.js, Laravel, TypeScript and SQL databases, plus IT systems, data analysis, and technical support. Recently shipped an AI-powered full-stack app (Next.js + OpenAI) with human-in-the-loop approval.

Key facts: open to full-stack / web development / IT data analysis roles; English and Filipino; remote or Philippines-based.
